title: Jaguars look to match best six-game start in team history

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jaguars look to match best six-game start in team history
sources.description: As the Jaguars prepare to play their second straight game in London, they have an opportunity to do something they haven't done in 27 years — start the year 5-1.
